newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen flat in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen flat in slow trading.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen flat in slow trading on Friday as players are likely to stay sidelined due to weak sentiment on the rupiah, brokers said.
"Some firms have started announcing their first half results, so far there have been no major positive surprises which could boost sentiment," one broker said.
Bank Bira announced on Friday a sharp rise in its first half net profit, but Kalbe Farma said its first half net profit rose only slightly.
Brokers said players were waiting for the first half results of big-capitalised stocks following news that tobacco company Sampoerna had posted below-expected first half sales.
The Jakarta composite index fell 6.14 points to close at 712.05 points on Thursday.
Tin miner Tambang Timah and cement giant Semen Gresik were among the losers due to worries of weak first half earnings, brokers said.
Timah fell 50 rupiah to 3,050 rupiah after hitting a year low of 3,025 rupiah, surpassing the previous year low of 3,100 rupiah on Thursday. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
